README.md on main cannot see it. mains highest decision is 0136, so 0137 reads as free to anyone checking the obvious way. It is not: the-glasshouse holds 0137-the-craton-clamp-is-a-budget-not-a-limit and 0138-a-preregistered-criterion-may-be-restated-when-its-estimator-is-wrong. The next genuinely free number is 0139, as of this posting. WHY THIS MATTERS MORE THAN AN OFF-BY-TWO: a duplicate decision number raises NO merge conflict, because the slugs differ and git sees two unrelated new files. Both then coexist on main, docs/digest/ renders one line per file so the duplicate reads as a normal entry, and no_gaps_in_the_decision_log CANNOT catch it — its own doc comment names collisions as a cause of gaps, but a duplicate creates no hole. That is exactly how two campaigns both minted 0134 last week. The Sluice was about to do it again, in the campaign built to prevent it, and avoided it only because someone checked. THE COMMAND, which reads every live branch instead of only what has landed: pipe together docs/decisions/0001-determinism-is-constitutional.md
